scope: First responses to typed, natural English 'between' requests on actual UAE driver-view photos. Frames and current RF-DETR/BoT-SORT predictions only. No new fitting. Prospective negatives include blocked or ambiguous scenes. No test of physical vehicle fit or permission to stop.
method: Qwen3.5-9B identifies two current vehicles, Mapillary Mask2Former supplies parking-surface pixels, and Qwen chooses among the marked points or asks for clarification.

methods.native: Default unassisted passenger app, tuned 8B plus prior road checks
methods.old: Same 9B selecting from original road points
methods.parking: Same 9B selecting parking points across possible vehicle pairs
methods.anchor-parking: Same 9B identifying the referenced pair first, then selecting from its parking points

fresh_reference.reviewer: Independent AI visual reviewer; no passenger participants
fresh_reference.originals: 10 source sequences; none matched the 123 previously surveyed or the airport image
fresh_reference.rules: Reference polygons established before scoring. Continuous original-image point in polygon, boundary included. Only explicit asks count as correct clarifications.
